title: Favourite Books List
prompt: Create an ordered list of reading steps and an unordered list of at least two favourite books.
objective: Use both ol and ul and include li children for each item.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: ordered, unordered, and nested lists.
hints: The order of steps matters; the order of book titles does not. Choose ol and ul accordingly.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: The order of steps matters; the order of book titles does not. Choose ol and ul accordingly. Required structural evidence: <ol>, <ul>, <li>.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
